hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git push'; then files=$(git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -lE "(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|sk-ant-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+|sk_live_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|sk_test_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+|sbp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{40})" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$files" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Possible secrets detected — push blocked. Check these files: $files\"}"; exit 2; fi; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *.py ]]; then ruff check "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; mypy "$file" --ignore-missing-imports 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$file" == *.ts || "$file" == *.tsx ]]; then cd /Users/saitoukaito/develop/dev/samurai-stats/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null || true; fi
